rules: UK retail: spot only. The FCA bans crypto derivatives for retail consumers, so there are no down-bets, no leverage and no funding payments. Coins limited to those with a GBP pair on Coinbase: BTC, ETH, SOL, AAVE.

finalists.name: BTC
finalists.thesis_short: ETF creations flipped 2026 flows positive; funding moderate, not euphoric. Trend-following on flow, not a valuation call. UK spot: up-bets only, held for hours to days so each trade can clear about 1.2% of round-trip fees.
finalists.invalidation_short: ETF flows turn net negative for a week, or funding above 0.03%/8h with falling price, or daily close back below the September breakout.

finalists.name: ETH
finalists.thesis_short: Open interest at a four-month high with ETF flows mixed; a leverage-led move that can run or unwind. Trade both sides. UK spot: up-bets only, held for hours to days so each trade can clear about 1.2% of round-trip fees.
finalists.invalidation_short: OI keeps rising while price stalls (crowded longs), or ETF outflows resume for a full week.

finalists.name: SOL
finalists.thesis_short: Twelve straight weeks of US spot ETF inflows and ~70% staked supply; Alpenglow finality upgrade is a speculative catalyst (still in testing, no confirmed mainnet date). UK spot: up-bets only, held for hours to days so each trade can clear about 1.2% of round-trip fees.
finalists.invalidation_short: ETF inflow streak breaks, or Alpenglow slips with no date, or network outage.

finalists.name: AAVE
finalists.thesis_short: Aavenomics 3.0 (live since 2026-06-27) routes protocol revenue to open-market buybacks; revenue is organic interest spread, not emissions. UK spot: up-bets only, held for hours to days so each trade can clear about 1.2% of round-trip fees.
finalists.invalidation_short: Borrow revenue keeps falling, buyback budget cut again, or a bad-debt event on a major market.

finalists.name: LINK
finalists.thesis_short: Chainlink (LINK): a top-100 coin with a Coinbase GBP market, added 2026-09-25 at the operator's request. No coin-specific research thesis: trade price action only (trend, order-book flow, volatility) and stay neutral unless the set-up is clear. UK spot: up-bets only, held for hours to days so each trade can clear about 1.2% of round-trip fees.
finalists.invalidation_short: Spread wider than 1%, GBP volume collapsing, or the pair being delisted or limited by Coinbase.
